title: St. James defensive block against leader
description: St. James defensive block against leader. Blocking the leader's orange monopoly is worth a limited defensive bid. The hard part is resisting drop_out when monopoly potential and cash survival point in opposite directions.

final_action.private_thought: St. James Place completes my orange monopoly (Kentucky, Indiana, St. James). Owning the set enables house building for high ROI. I have $470 cash; bidding $210 leaves $260 for houses and other needs. Beta and Delta may outbid, but $210 is a strong yet reasonable amount to secure the property without overpaying.
